reviews.title: Rhythm interrupted in acceleration
reviews.text: It used to be that when the tempo went through a scheduled increase (while set to incrementally increase tempo) it was dimmer seamlessly. But these days, there is a disruptive interruption in the rhythm when it happens. This is a DEALBREAKING bug.

reviews.title: Battery hog
reviews.text:
I uninstalled this app because in the last few days it started chugging my battery. It's been running for hours in the background. Why is a metronome app doing anything in the background? Is it mining Bitcoin?

Also the metronome timing drifts when you are using Airpods.

reviews.title: Excellent App Ruined By Greed
reviews.text:
This is the first time I’ve had an app take away free features… but I guess we are living in the age of greed. 

I have been using this app very happily in the free mode for about 3 months daily since I bought a Soundbrenner smartwatch to use while I practice. After paying hundreds of dollars for a premium Soundbrenner model, it began nagging me to pay for a paid subscription but I just said no. Over and over and over. But I found the free version to have plenty of useful features so it became where I logged my daily practice. I was happy to be able to see my streak and haven’t missed a day in months. As a result, this app has been used on my phone for an average of one to two hours a day for months. 

But tonight I went in to look back at my streak and not it’s grayed out. Nope, can’t see the time that I logged last month or the previous months anymore. I can’t see the hour totals I had worked on for each month anymore. Nope, not unless I upgrade. What’s next I can’t even use the app without a subscription? 

This was by far the best metronome app with a journaling feature out there. Excellent job by the creators of an app that is unfortunately ruined by the greed of the business team. 

After paying you hundreds of dollars for the hardware, that was partly sold based on the app, now that’s not enough, you gotta squeeze me for more? You take away the features that sold me on your product. Bye bye Soundbrenner. It was nice while it lasted. You lost my trust in your business p

reviews.title: Lacks basic user functionality
reviews.text:
Screen orientation is locked to portrait. Requests for orientation functionality have fallen on deaf ears. I have sent suggestions to the developers to no avail. (Minus one star for this…) Other user functionality that is not addressed is the use of bluetooth pedals. I use AirTurn bluetooth pedals and they work on EVERY OTHER metronome app. Pedals work for a moment, and then it places a cursor in the BPM number on the metronome page. No way to get this “out” of the “edit” mode without touching the screen with your finger; hence, totally negating the reason for the pedals. (Minus one star for this…) The good is: it is a plan, so multiple users can use it to practice without passing a device around. Our church uses this for all drummers and all services. It has a great count in (although, it sometimes glitches), multiple time signature options, and easy recall from songs already in your “master” list (finally). Would I recommend it? Short answer: no. Long answer: if you don’t care about screen orientation or inability to use bluetooth pedals, yes. Good luck, and happy drumming!

UPDATE 1/25/25: Still no landscape layout, still glitches (I automatically close the app and restart it every time I get on stage to avoid the “munchkin” count in glitch), and, lately, it doesn’t save songs in the “song list” when you create them- or maybe every once in a while at best.

Still my least favorite temp app that is more concerned about you buying their accessories than listening to users. I

reviews.title: I’m sending my Pulse back. Basic functionality is absent
reviews.text:
My Pulse only arrived yesterday and I already want to send it back. Having invested over £100 in your device, I'm disappointed to find that 12/8 — one of the most common time signatures in music — cannot be properly configured with a dotted crotchet as the beat unit. This feels like a significant omission for a premium metronome product.
Yes, I could use a 4/4 time signature but why do I have to use a workaround because you want be bothered to produce a functional metronome?

reviews.title: Keep it simple!
reviews.text: Far too many distracting features. I only want a metronome. I don’t need reminders to practise or “practice streaks”. As if an annoying app could badger me to practise.

reviews.title: App Crashes
reviews.text: This App used to be great. Now it crashes on my iPad whenever I try to access my libraries. Sort it guys or I’ll have to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Why is this app so bloated now?
reviews.text:
I have used this app for my metronome for many years now. Never used to have a problem, the metronome function was versatile and simple to use - perfect!

However over the years it seems to have strayed further and further from its main function, and now even the actual metronome itself doesn’t have its own tab in the mess that is the home screen!

Why do I need to make an account in order to use a metronome? Why does it take multiple clicks just to get to it? Why am I getting adverts every time I try and click on it?

This app would be so much better split into two - one app for just the metronome itself, and another app for use with the Soundbrenner devices. Why call it “Metronome” if that’s not even its main function anymore?
